modmenu.descriptionTranslation.visual-sn: Snowy leaves that works for you, everywhere (especially servers).
visual-snowy-leaves.config.title: Visual Snowy Leaves Config
visual-snowy-leaves.config.option.enable: Applies snowy effects on leaves based on specific conditions.
visual-snowy-leaves.config.option.requir: Leaves will only turn snowy in biomes that snow.
Leaves will only turn snowy when it's raining or snowing.
visual-snowy-leaves.config.option.catego: Values are formatted as: hours, colon, minutes, colon, seconds, plus, ticks. Hours may be omitted first, then minutes; ticks may be omitted.
visual-snowy-leaves.config.option.rebuil: The delay between requests for chunks to be rebuild during transition.
visual-snowy-leaves.config.option.freshF: The time it takes for fully green leaves to begin transitioning into their snowy color.
visual-snowy-leaves.config.option.transi: The time it takes for leaves to transition.
visual-snowy-leaves.config.option.fullMe: The time it takes for fully snowed leaves to begin transitioning into their vegetative color.
visual-snowy-leaves.config.option.catego: Each advance option requires a separate screen to customize.
visual-snowy-leaves.config.option.target: Blocks affected by snowy effects. Best applicable to leaves with grayscale textures based on the tinting system.
